title: Feedback
description: Submit ideas and vote on them to shape the future of Wiki.js

content.intro:
To submit new ideas, upvote and comment, a **GitHub login** is required. Click the **Submit Idea** button below or upvote an existing idea to get started.

Do **NOT** submit bug reports here. Use [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/requarks/wiki/discussions/categories/3-x-error-bug-report) instead.
